name: k6-typescript-template
description: Opinionated starter for safe, continuous API performance testing with k6.
author: Sergio Cuadros

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:report && npm run test:baseline && npm run test:openapi && npm run test:routes && npm run test:demo && npm run test:inspect && npm run recipes:inspect
scripts.recipes:inspect: k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://api.example.invalid/protected -e TOKEN_URL=https://auth.example.invalid/oauth/token -e OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_SECRET=oauth-client-id -e OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET=oauth-client-secret recipes/oauth-client-credentials.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://api.example.invalid recipes/graphql.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://api.example.invalid recipes/file-upload.ts
scripts.test:demo: npm run demo && npm run demo:fail
scripts.test:inspect: k6 inspect src/tests/smoke.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e AUTH_SECRET_NAME=auth-token src/tests/authenticated-smoke.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e ENVIRONMENT=staging -e ALLOW_LOAD_TEST=true src/tests/average-load.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e ENVIRONMENT=staging -e ALLOW_LOAD_TEST=true src/tests/capacity.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e ENVIRONMENT=staging -e ALLOW_LOAD_TEST=true src/tests/stress.ts
